chapter: Parisian Room and Bourbon Street clubs
title: Mirrored ball, bandstand layout and Ken Collier photo
summary: The two recall the mirrored ball, bandstand position and redecoration at Manny's, and Steinau's lack of contact with Ken Collier.

But that was before, you know, that's before they got to be sold by Edmund Scientific Company.
Now they're sold by a scientific company.

Well I don't, I'm sure other places sell them too but if you happen to want a mirrored ball, Edmund Scientific Company still has them in the catalog I'm pretty sure. For scientific purposes?
